01.steps:
1.Make some successful changes as well as some failed configuration.
2.Go to Log Settings/ Auditing Records page, check the records.
01.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
01.title: Verify the records are displayed in correct format
01.result: The Auditing Records are displayed in correct format

04.steps:
Go to Log Settings/Automation, enter the correct Email address and Mail Server settings for E-mail Audit Records Automation.
Log Settings/ Auditing Records page, click the icon "Export Auditing Records by Email".
Go to your mailbox, check if Auditing Records are received.
04.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
04.title: Verify the records can be exported by Email correctly
04.result: Auditing Records are received in the mail box, and are displayed properly.

06.steps:
Go to Log Settings/ Auditing Records page, click the icon "Export Auditing Records as CSV File".
Check the records downloaded.
06.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
06.title: Verify the records can be exported as CSV File correctly
06.result: Auditing Records is exported as CSV File correctly

08.steps:
Go to Log Settings/ Auditing Records page, click the icon "Display Auditing Records on Console"
Make some configuration on the firewall.
Check the console outputs.

------Edit by Celia-----
In UI7, to find "Display Auditing Records on Console", user should go to Monitor/Logs/Auditing Logs page, click 'Supplemental' icon, then the button shows.
08.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
08.title: Verify it's able to display Auditing Records on  Console properly
08.result: New Auditing Records are printed on Console.

30.steps:
Make some changes on the firewall.
Go to Log Settings/ Auditing Records page,  check the Old Value and New Value of the records
30.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
30.title: Verify the Old Value and New Value of the records
30.result: Old Value and New Value of the records are correct

41.steps:
Login from GUI.
Go to Diag page, uncheck the option Enable Configuration Auditing and apply.
Make some changes on the firewall to trigger both successful and failed configurations.
Go to Log/ Auditing Records page, check if the configurations are audited.
41.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
41.title: Disable Configuration Auditing from the Diag page
41.result: When Configuration Auditing is disabled on Diag page, new configuration is not audited

44.steps:
Login from CLI.
Issue the following commands:
config(C0EAE49CE84C)# log audit settings
(config-audit)# enable
(config-audit)# commit

Check the status of option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' on diag page. Result 1.
Make some changes on the firewall to trigger both successful and failed configurations.
Go to Log/ Auditing Records page, check if the configurations are audited. Result 2.
44.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
44.title: Enable Configuration Auditing from CLI
44.result:
When Configuration Auditing is enabled on CLI, the option is disabled on diag page too.
New configuration is audited.

47.steps:
Make some changes on the firewall to trigger both successful and failed configurations auditing.
Go to Log/ Auditing Records page, make sure there are records.
Reboot the DUT.
Check the  Log/ Auditing Records page again.
47.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
47.title: Verify Auditing Records persistence support
47.result: For NSA series firewall, the Auditing Records should be kept after the reboot

56.steps:
1.Configure X4 as LAN and set IP/Subnet, save
2.Export currenty prefs file in Device->Firmware and settings page
3.Change X4 to unassigned state
4.Import the prefs that exported in step2
5.After firewall boots up check the audit log
56.initial: 1.The option 'Enable Configuration Auditing' is checked on diag page.
56.title: can generate audit record when reboot fireware after import the configuration files.
56.result: Audit log should show "import settings" log with "succeed" transaction status.
